== Biography ==

Father William is an old man whose white hair marks the passage of years, and whose uncommonly fat form suggests a life of comfort rather than hardship. He is most distinguished by an unusual and persistent habit: standing on his head incessantly, despite his advanced age. He has even managed to perform a back-somersault while passing through a doorway—a display of agility that belies his years.

When his son questioned the wisdom of such acrobatics at his advanced age, Father William shared his philosophy. In his youth, he had feared that standing on his head might injure his brain; but he is now convinced otherwise. "Now that I'm perfectly sure I have none," he declared, "Why, I do it again and again." True to this conviction, Father William continues to stand on his head without hesitation, heedless of his son's concerns.
